attacks.name: Pistol
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.

|!hit| |*Rapid Fire|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make 1 additional |*Pistol| attack. The additional attack must target the original defender and does not have the |*Rapid Fire| special rule.

attacks.name: Espionage
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

superPowers.name: Freedom Force (Affiliation: Brotherhood of Mutants)
superPowers.body: Once per Turn, after an allied character Interacts with an Extract objective token, after all effects are resolved, the allied character gains 1 |!power|.|\|Additionally, allied characters may use the following Interact ability:|\||*Interact (Secure Objective Token)|: Place a token on that objective token. While that token is in play, this character's controlling player Secures that objective. Remove that token if an enemy character Contests that objective. Only 1 token at a time may be in play as a result of this |!leadership| ability.

superPowers.name: Expert Sabotage
superPowers.body: |*Action|: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 3 or less within |!range| 4 of this character. Enemy characters within |!range| 1 of the terrain feature suffer 2 |!damage|. The terrain feature is destroyed and removed from the battlefield. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Martial Artist
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!energy| attack targeting it from within |!range| 2, this character adds Blanks in its defense roll to its total successes.

superPowers.name: Shapeshifter
superPowers.body: During this character's Activation, enemy characters cannot use |!reactive| superpowers or Reactive Team Tactic Cards.
